subject: Exploring developer community fit for DevCon APAC 2027
body:
Hello APAC Developer Relations / Partnerships team,

We are exploring sponsors for a proposed Singapore developer conference in 2027 focused on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering. Would your team be open to a conversation about audience fit and the information you would need to evaluate participation?

We can share the proposed format and discuss whether there is a relevant partnership opportunity.

Sponsor Desk demo team
